title: BPSC Agriculture Various Post Recruitment 2026
summary: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released a Notification on its official website for the recruitment of Agriculture Department Various posts. This recruitment is for 147 positions. The BPSC application process will start on 15 December 2026 , and candidates were able to submit their applications until 12 January 2027 . The minimum age is 21 Years & the maximum age is 37 – 42 years as on 01 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for the BPSC Agriculture Various Post Recruitment 2026 provided below.
